label_audit.reason: All 459 features are thaw-slump records. N means inactive RTS, not non-RTS. Unlisted background is unlabelled. Shared input inventories and inconsistent object boundaries prevent independent event/onset validation. A binary classifier has no verified negative class; fitting pseudo-negatives would not validate RTS identification.
label_audit.limitations: Counts audit the available local public sources, not all possible labels worldwide. No accuracy/PR-AUC/confusion matrix claimed.

rts-1820.limitations: NDVI flags count isolated deviations, whereas S-CCD segments identify sustained multiband structural changes; counts are not directly comparable accuracy measures. No true-negative labels or independent onset truth. Residuals use the segment available at first detection, never shown earlier.
